summary: Bank of Montreal filed a Form 6-K containing an earnings coverage ratio exhibit (Ex-99.1) as required under Canadian NI 44-102 for shelf distributions. The filing discloses interest and dividend coverage ratios for the 12 months ended April 30, 2026 and October 31, 2025. There are no deal terms, no acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situations activity. This is a routine regulatory disclosure of financial metrics, not an event-driven special situation.
